moments.text: Pale, grainy infrared view down on the sea, crosshair and corner brackets at centre; dark blots upper left and right of centre.
The picture flickers through two blank frames, then returns zoomed in with reversed shading: dark grey background, bright white clouds.
A tiny white dot hovers just left of and below the crosshair, inside the brackets, while white clouds drift up through the frame: zoom in.
The clouds clear; the dot stays just below the crosshair on a plain dark background.
A bright coastline rises from the lower right toward the crosshair.
Land fills the view under the crosshair and the dot can no longer be picked out.
